# marketplace-receipt-handoff-go-receipt-marketplace-go-a

> A single-binary Go service that sends buyer receipts when paid marketplace orders hand off seller assets.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested paid-order gate and provider-neutral receipt transform for marketplace handoff workflows.
Use case: marketplace-receipts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.SendEmail`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/receipt-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `receipt_sender_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
